5 min of talking (after completing the required quests)

The hero {npc:Avar Tar}, in Edron, is fed up with inexperienced would-be heroes and only hands over the Demon Outfit to those who have proven their worth against demons. The base outfit requires the {wiki:Annihilator Quest}, the shield addon the {wiki:Demon Helmet Quest} and the helmet addon the {wiki:Demon Oak Quest} and the 6666 Demon kills.
Find a hero who recognises your fight against the demons of Tibia.
Base outfit: have completed the {wiki:Annihilator Quest}.
Shield addon: you must have completed the {wiki:Demon Helmet Quest}.
Helmet addon: having completed the {wiki:Demon Oak Quest} and having hunted all **6666** {creature:Demon|Demons}.
No items: Avar Tar only checks the quests you have completed
The dangers listed are from the required quests (Annihilator, Demon Helmet, Demon Oak and hunting Demons), not from talking to Avar Tar.
You can ask for each part as soon as you meet the respective requirement: you don't need to have everything done to receive the base outfit.

Go to **Edron** (if you are coming from another city, take a boat and say {key:hi}, {key:edron} and {key:yes} to the captain; you arrive at the port, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}) and talk to {npc:Avar Tar}, in the city. Say {key:hi}, {key:outfits}, {key:yes} and {key:base}.
Talk to {npc:Avar Tar} and say {key:hi}, {key:outfits}, {key:yes} and {key:shield}.
Requirements: {wiki:Demon Oak Quest} completed and the 6666 {creature:Demon|Demons} kills.
Talk to {npc:Avar Tar} and say {key:hi}, {key:outfits}, {key:yes} and {key:helmet}.
The reward for this quest also includes the achievement **True Dedication**.
